invariants.rationale: An instant time identifier should almost always be non-null for commit operations.
The method is designed to operate on a prepared list of records; null would likely be invalid input.
The context is essential for distributed/engine operations—null context would typically not be supported.
A List's size is never negative; this checks list usage and allows safe calls to isEmpty() and size().
Hudi commit instant times are almost always required to be non-empty strings.
